name: Reconstructed C1 small shop, grocery, or land office #047

grade.why: Placed by our reconstruction of the town; no source pictures or records it here.

documented_range.note: Anonymous count-unit of the commercial core's row fill (T-3605): the owner's reading of Gifford's drawing of the first Tremont House's street, spread over South Water and Lake from Wells to State at about 70 % of each block front. No evidence establishes that this particular building existed, and no source names an occupant.

change_note: T-3605 raises this store in the commercial core's row fill; a better-evidenced named roof substitutes for it rather than adding to the town.

placement.position_note: PARTY-LINE FRONTAGE, DERIVED FROM THE COMMITTED PLAT (T-3605). It stands on the south face of blk_south_water_dearborn, whose line and bearing are read from the block boundary in data/traces/vectors/thompson_lots.json, at stations 83.87-89.22 m from the face's west end, its front wall 1.50 m behind the lot line (the plat module's margin, as the block programme's own party-line runs stand). The bearing is the face's, so the front looks square at Lake Street. The station is the row-fill rule's (largest open stretch first, until the face is about 70 % built), not a measurement.
placement.symbolic_location: Anonymous reconstructed store on the north side of Lake Street, in the block west-bounded by Dearborn Street; one unit of the street's row

siding_exposure_m.note: INVENTED WITHIN A STOCK SET, NOT DERIVED. No source states the exposed face of any Chicago building's siding. The value is one of four period mill sidings — 4.5, 5, 5.5 or 6 in to the weather; this roof wears 5 in — dealt in this building's own parcel recipe: drawn on this record's stable key from the stocks its household class may hang (5 in, 5.5 in or 6 in; T-1839, docs/LIBERTIES.md L352), then advanced within them so that no roof of the parcel standing within 60 m hangs the same course. It is NOT keyed to a construction season the way the named buildings' stocks are: this record's 1835-01-01 is the programme's count-unit convention and not a date anything was built, so keying to it would deal every anonymous roof in the town one stock. The separation is the surface variety T-0049 reconstructs, not a claim about 1835. docs/LIBERTIES.md L148 owns the invention and the recipe half is recorded beside it, under `tools/siding_stock.py`.
